definition.note: No closed form is stored for this surface. It is defined by its shipped implementation in math_art.minimal_polyhedron_generator, which is authoritative; an unverified transcription would silently define a different surface.

provenance.definition: Derived from the Math Art generator registries and cross-referenced to the literature; not transcribed from any gallery's compilation.
sources: Minimal surfaces / Plateau's problem: the pierced membrane approximates a soap film spanning the held edge frame.
Discrete membrane relaxation: U. Pinkall and K. Polthier, "Computing Discrete Minimal Surfaces and Their Conjugates", Experimental Mathematics 2(1), 1993, pp. 15-36.
Laplacian mesh smoothing: M. Desbrun, M. Meyer, P. Schroder, A. Barr, "Implicit Fairing of Irregular Meshes using Diffusion and Curvature Flow", SIGGRAPH 1999.
Quad-split topology: E. Catmull and J. Clark, "Recursively generated B-spline surfaces on arbitrary topological meshes", Computer-Aided Design 10(6), 1978.
